source: Benchmarks also depend on language, domain, text length, instructions, data contamination, and evaluation implementation. The current MTEB project has expanded far beyond the original text benchmark, including broader multilingual and multimodal evaluation, so leaderboard claims should always be dateand benchmark-scoped. [8]
zh: 基准还取决于语言、领域、文本长度、说明、数据污染和评估实施。目前的 MTEB 项目已经远远超出了原始文本基准，包括更广泛的多语言和多模式评估，因此排行榜声明应始终是日期和基准范围的。 [8]
